lexicon.name: DanaOS
lexicon.description: An advisory, bounded agent platform organized as a monorepo of durable state, runtimes, capability libraries, governance agents, model backends, adapters, and operator applications.

context.name: Durable Knowledge Substrate
context.description: The dana-odb substrate owns durable objects, service contracts, reasoning artifacts, DQL, and the WorldModel extension point used by agents and model families.

concept.name: ODB Contracts
concept.description: Typed service and object contracts through which runtime components read and write missions, tasks, artifacts, evidence, outcomes, and governed capabilities.
concept.code-link: Defines the durable knowledge object vocabulary owned by the substrate.

concept.name: Mission State
concept.description: The episode-scoped state that groups a mission's world slice, tasks, artifacts, execution records, and outcome evidence.
concept.code-link: The runtime client reads and writes mission-scoped state through the ODB HTTP contract.

concept.name: World Model Contract
concept.description: A pluggable model interface that lets DQL and agent compositions resolve simulation or learned model behavior through a declared capability.
concept.code-link: Declares the WorldModel trait and registry used by the DQL executor.

context.annotation: Agent identity belongs to a governed composition, while missions and tasks represent episodic work in the agent's ODB.

context.name: Bounded Agent Runtime
context.description: The dana-agent runtime executes one governed agent invocation with bounded workflow, tool, evidence, fault, and provider behavior.

concept.name: Agent Invocation
concept.description: The gateway operation that resolves an agent profile, binds its control surface, dispatches its workflow or leaf execution, and returns an AgentResult.
concept.code-link: Dispatches a bounded agent request through the runtime gateway.

concept.name: STAR Execution
concept.description: The in-house leaf path that executes See, Think, Act, and Reflect behavior through explicit runtime ports and a trace.
concept.code-link: Builds and runs the STAR leaf used by agent compositions.
Runs the STAR phase sequence and produces the leaf outcome.
concept.annotation: The runtime remains advisory: external actuation is refused until a governed actuation contract exists.

concept.name: Agent Authoring Session
concept.description: The local authoring workflow for drafting, evaluating, gym-checking, approving, and granting tools to an agent catalog entry.
concept.code-link: Coordinates the authoring lifecycle and its evidence checks.

concept.name: Agent Result
concept.description: The structured result of a bounded invocation, including answer or recommendation, refusal state, and execution evidence.
concept.code-link: Represents the gateway's caller-visible result.

context.name: Loop Orchestration
context.description: The dana-loop package pursues a configured goal over repeated plan, act, observe, evaluate, compress, and completion or fail-safe transitions.

concept.name: Loop Graph
concept.description: The bounded state graph that routes a loop through planning, execution, observation, evaluation, compression, and terminal states.
concept.code-link: Constructs the loop's executable state graph and routing nodes.

concept.name: Loop Run
concept.description: A long-running goal pursuit that owns its current state, budget, steering, telemetry, and terminal outcome.
concept.code-link: Runs a loop graph against a PlanDef and repository context.
concept.annotation: Loop orchestration owns multi-step goal pursuit; single-agent tool execution remains in dana-agent.

concept.name: Loop Record
concept.description: The durable registry representation of a loop's identity, status, goal, and resumable run metadata.
concept.code-link: Defines the loop registry record and its ODB projection.

context.name: Capability Libraries
context.description: The dana-lib packages provide reusable execution, memory, authentication, resolver, and structural-vocabulary capabilities without becoming a second runtime.

concept.name: Graph Control Kernel
concept.description: The shared graph engine compiles, invokes, resumes, and traces bounded execution for both dana-agent and dana-loop.
concept.code-link: Provides compile, invoke, trace, and resume operations for graph runtimes.

concept.name: Memory Client
concept.description: The typed client for lookup, content resolution, governed memory decisions, and write-back over ODB contracts.
concept.code-link: Implements the memory capability surface over an ODB JSON client.

concept.name: Token Acquisition
concept.description: The authentication capability obtains runtime and compatibility access tokens and extracts verified principals when authentication is configured.
concept.code-link: Resolves the runtime access token used by governed service calls.

concept.name: Resolver Registry
concept.description: The shared adapter contract routes external data requests by cache-key prefix to registered resolver implementations.
concept.code-link: Registers and dispatches external-data resolvers.

concept.name: Structural Pack Registry
concept.description: The metamodel registry loads domain-blind structural vocabulary packs and validates their kinds, relations, and containment declarations.
concept.code-link: Owns explicit registration and lookup of structural packs.

context.name: Governance And Product Agents
context.description: Product-surface agents curate knowledge, retrieve data, coach authoring, and expose draft-only ontology review over the shared runtime and ODB contracts.

concept.name: Ontology Curation
concept.description: The ontologist's curation path parses agent knowledge, validates provenance and alignment, and stages governed domain-pack or skill changes.
concept.code-link: Runs the curation workflow that prepares governed knowledge writeback.
concept.annotation: Curation proposes or publishes governed knowledge; it does not become the owner of an agent's execution runtime.

concept.name: Librarian Retrieval
concept.description: The Librarian returns data with provenance by reading visible skills and driving MCP-brokered external connectors; it does not diagnose or mutate Layer-A state.
concept.code-link: Runs the Librarian's STAR-backed retrieval agent.
concept.annotation: The Librarian's NG5 boundary is data plus provenance, never diagnosis.

concept.name: Authoring Coach
concept.description: Dana coaches operators through loop and agent artifact authoring while leaving execution and promotion decisions to their governed paths.
concept.code-link: Runs the wizard's skill-guided authoring interaction.

concept.name: Runtime Ontology Review
concept.description: A public runtime adapter that turns an operator request into a draft ontology review with scoped ODB tooling and evidence.
concept.code-link: Handles a draft-only ontology review request.
Defines the review result contract returned by the adapter.

context.name: Model Families
context.description: The dana-models package supplies specialized simulator and learned model families that implement declared WorldModel capabilities for agent compositions.

concept.name: Simulator Backend
concept.description: A deterministic or external simulator adapter that produces model observations and scores for a declared scenario.
concept.code-link: Implements a Honeywell building-run simulation entrypoint.

concept.name: Learned Model Family
concept.description: A trained model family such as CHARM or JEPA time-series models that can serve learned prediction or representation behavior.
concept.code-link: Defines the CHARM learned model family.

context.name: Operator Applications
context.description: CLI and visual applications expose DanaOS capabilities to operators and developers while delegating execution and governance to package-owned contracts.

concept.name: Unified CLI
concept.description: The dana command dispatches agent, ODB, ontology, loop, librarian, wizard, model, and verification operations from one front door.
concept.code-link: Dispatches the unified dana command surface.

concept.name: Console Graph Host
concept.description: The console's customer-interpreter graph host loads an attached LangGraph module and emits a plain JSON topology for visual inspection.
concept.code-link: Runs the standalone graph inspection host.

concept.name: Daily Brief
concept.description: The daily brief application collects standing mission inputs and runs a bounded mission to produce an operator brief.
concept.code-link: Runs one daily brief mission.

context.name: External Data Adapters
context.description: Provider packages translate external systems into the shared resolver contract and remain separate from runtime execution and durable state ownership.

concept.name: Honeywell Resolver
concept.description: A provider resolver that maps Honeywell asset, zone temperature, EBI point, Find series, and weather requests into normalized resolver results.
concept.code-link: Implements a Honeywell resolver over the shared adapter protocol.
Exports the provider's resolver collection for registration.

context.name: Structural Vocabulary
context.description: Domain-blind metamodel packs declare reusable kinds, relations, and containment, separately from operational packs, external fetching, and model instances.

concept.name: Structural Pack
concept.description: A versioned pack declaration that contributes structural vocabulary over the metamodel contract.
concept.code-link: Declares the spatial structural vocabulary pack.
Declares the chemical structural vocabulary pack.
concept.annotation: Structural packs contain vocabulary only; instances, fetching, reasoning, and model execution belong to other contexts.

relationship.name: reads and writes
relationship.description: A bounded agent invocation exchanges its mission artifacts, world slice, execution context, trace, and outcome with the durable substrate through ODB contracts.
relationship.code-link: Provides the mission-scoped HTTP operations used by runtime execution.

relationship.name: delegates bounded work to
relationship.description: The loop orchestrator may use agent execution as its act step while retaining ownership of goal pursuit, budgets, routing, and terminal loop state.
relationship.code-link: Adapts agent invocation into a loop runner.

relationship.name: is registered as
relationship.description: Each loop run is represented by a registry record that supports status inspection and resumption.
relationship.code-link: Defines the persisted loop identity and status projection.

relationship.name: supports execution for
relationship.description: The shared graph kernel supplies compilation, bounded invocation, tracing, and resume semantics to the runtime consumers.
relationship.code-link: Implements the shared graph execution seam.

relationship.name: resolves and records through
relationship.description: Memory decisions, content resolution, episodic records, and governed lessons are persisted through ODB-facing client operations.
relationship.code-link: Implements memory reads and write-back on top of an ODB JSON client.

relationship.name: implements capabilities of
relationship.description: Simulator and learned model families supply declared behavior behind the WorldModel contract owned by the durable substrate.
relationship.code-link: Defines the trait and registry that model backends target.

relationship.name: supplies learned behavior for
relationship.description: Learned model families are available as specialized backends alongside simulators; their registration and serving path remains governed by the WorldModel contract.
relationship.code-link: Defines one learned model family that can participate in the model backend tier.

relationship.name: reviews and governs
relationship.description: The ontologist curation path supplies governance checks and writeback boundaries around the knowledge and artifacts authored for agents.
relationship.code-link: Runs validation and staging for curated agent knowledge.

relationship.name: drives external retrieval through
relationship.description: The Librarian selects allowed connector tools and delegates provider access through registered resolver or MCP adapter contracts.
relationship.code-link: Runs the retrieval agent that dispatches connector-backed tools.

relationship.name: routes requests to
relationship.description: The generic registry selects a provider implementation based on the request's cache-key prefix.
relationship.code-link: Performs prefix routing and result normalization.

relationship.name: coaches creation of
relationship.description: The wizard helps operators produce valid agent or loop artifacts while leaving execution and promotion decisions to governed workflows.

relationship.name: exposes
relationship.description: The unified CLI is an operator entry point for agent execution and related ODB, loop, ontology, model, and verification commands.
relationship.code-link: Dispatches commands to the runtime and package front doors.

relationship.name: visualizes
relationship.description: The console graph host reads an attached graph module and emits topology data for operator inspection.
relationship.code-link: Projects a compiled graph into the console's JSON topology.
